name: Гигантский скунс
alt: Пухлый гигантский скунс восседает на брошенных доспехах, разгоняя всех зелёными завитками запаха.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384 by 384 pixels. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment. Saturated character colors, simple chunky shapes, a strong readable silhouette and one visual joke. Large centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery. Modest detail appropriate for a small card. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border, card frame or separate panels. Do not imitate an existing copyrighted card illustration. Clear plausible anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: One gigantic plump black-and-white fantasy skunk with a huge arched fluffy tail, four legs and two tiny ears. It grins proudly while sitting on a little heap of discarded cloth armor and boots. Stylized pale green spirals of odor drift behind its tail; one fly wearing a miniature clothespin on its nose retreats in the distance. No human arms, no extra paws, no realistic filth, no lettering.
